status: Integrated global source expansion; see dated source checks and job evidence in maintenance-runs.
method: Bounded global first pass combining direct employer pages, employer-authored AJO and INSPIRE records, national/society boards and hidden departmental sources.
Every verified addition has advertisement evidence. Dates are stored by actual meaning: hard, priority, review-start or EOI. Passed priority dates do not establish closure.
All source attempts remain partial or failed. No source has been promoted to a complete board scan; actual retries and failures remain recorded.
Counts are ledger source-check entries and distinct source URLs, not unique employers or necessarily independent network requests. Some API/public-page pairs and retries refer to one advertisement.
INSPIRE broad query returned first 250 of 5158 results; API normalized a two-rank request to JUNIOR in self/next links. Senior-only/all-board coverage is incomplete.
GeoNames locations are explicitly city-level, corroborated by employer-advertised localities; US NCES coordinates and Carnegie labels are delegated to parent integration.
